description: This file defines a final class 'BackgroundSyncStream' responsible for merging and analyzing streams of metadata related to thing snapshots and search index entries to detect inconsistencies and trigger updates within a larger indexing or synchronization system. It includes methods for filtering, comparison, and handling external resource requests, primarily using Akka Streams concepts.

classes.name: BackgroundSyncStream
classes.description: A utility class that merges streams of Metadata objects from snapshot and search index sources to identify and process inconsistencies for synchronization purposes. It includes filtering, comparison, and policy retrieval logic to maintain index consistency.

methods.name: BackgroundSyncStream.of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of BackgroundSyncStream with specified configuration parameters.

methods.name: BackgroundSyncStream.filterForInconsistencies
methods.description: Produces a stream of Metadata entries that are inconsistent between persisted snapshots and search index, suitable for processing updates or cleanups.

methods.name: BackgroundSyncStream.compareMetadata
methods.description: Compares two Metadata objects based on their ThingId for sorting and consistency checks.

methods.name: BackgroundSyncStream.compareThingIds
methods.description: Compares two ThingId objects to determine their ordering, considering dummy status and natural ordering.
